english.note: Use this for dull, un imaginative writing that merely records events in a tedious sequence.

examples.english: Your work report is just dull prose, merely listing what happened item by item.
examples.traditional: 你份工作報告寫到成篇流水帳，淨係逐項記低發生過咩事。
